Body Fat Calculator

Estimate body fat percentage with the US Navy tape-measure method and see your fitness category.

Estimate only — tape measurements vary with placement and time of day. Measure consistently for trends.

📖 How to use

  1. Select your sex.
  2. Enter height, neck and waist in cm.
  3. Women: also enter hip in cm.
  4. Read your estimated body fat % and category.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the US Navy method?

The US Navy formulas use log10 of tape measurements. Men: 495/(1.0324 − 0.19077·log10(waist−neck) + 0.15456·log10(height)) − 450. Women add hip: 495/(1.29579 − 0.35004·log10(waist+hip−neck) + 0.22100·log10(height)) − 450.

How accurate is it?

Within a few percentage points for most people — better than BMI, worse than DEXA. Tape placement and time of day shift results, so measure consistently.

Do women need the hip measurement?

Yes — select female and the hip field appears. The female formula needs it.
